messages:
maria: hey team — first week question: I need to share a Grafana panel for a demo (read-only) and also get Datadog + Sentry access. who do I ping and any quick steps? :wave:
kevin: hi maria — welcome! :tada: For access, file an IAM ticket (link below) and add 'rdw-observability' group. For Grafana panel embed you can use an API key + iframe, but we prefer using an internal embed service. doc: https://redwood.internal/devex/grafana-embed
samir: short version: add to grafana org as Viewer, create an API key scoped to Viewer. to create key via CLI:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"maria-embed-key","role":"Viewer"}' \
  https://grafana.redwood/api/auth/keys
```
then use iframe `<iframe src="https://grafana.redwood/d-solo/..." />` with `kiosk` params. don't paste admin tokens in demos :grimacing:
alex: also, for Datadog access: add to the 'redwood-observability' team in Okta group sync. If you need SLO dashboards, give me the list and I can pin them. For Sentry: don't share DSN in public pages. If you need error preview for demo, use a proxy/relay or a short-lived project token.
maria: thanks!! where's the IAM ticket link? and who runs the embed service? i don't want to host tokens in the browser.
kevin: here's the ticket form: https://redwood.internal/ops/iam-request — choose "Observability Access". ping @alex for embed service ownership. we'll create a short-lived embed token for your demo.
alex: I can make a demo embed token valid for 24h. ping me with the dashboard uid. Also if you need Sentry sampling off for demo (so you don't flood prod), we can create a sandbox project.
maria: perfect — dashboard uid is `XyZ-12_ab`. sending the IAM ticket now. thanks everyone :heart:
devex-bot: Note: requested access will be approved by infra within 24-48 hours unless expedited.
kevin: also adding a quick checklist for you:
- submit IAM request
- add Grafana Viewer API key / request embed token
- request Datadog team add via Okta
- request Sentry project invite or sandbox
let us know if you want me to escalate for a same-day demo :+1:
maria: would appreciate same-day if possible — demo at 3pm today. escalating now. :)
